_description: Override / backfill genus → full hierarchy for TaiCOL taxa where the CSV omits kingdom/phylum/class/order/family. Triggered as Stage 3 of taicol_import.py after the taxon CSV backfill. Applied via SQL: UPDATE rows WHERE genus = key AND target_column IS NULL OR ''. Keys are genus Latin names; values follow taicol_names schema. Add new entries as you encounter missing-hierarchy taxa.
_format: genus_name → {kingdom, kingdom_c, phylum, phylum_c, class, class_c, order, order_c, family, family_c}

_added.2026-05-17: initial seed for 4 vascular plant genera missing hierarchy after TaiCOL 20260424 import: Amydrium / Kallstroemia / Japanobotrychum (鈍裂雷公連 / 大番蒺藜 / etc.)
